title: Boss Rematch
topic: Boss Battle: Week 1 algebra mix (Instant Replay: check by plugging back in)

scenes.sub: Same moves, plus a secret weapon
scenes.say: Math Blitz, day eight! The Boss got away yesterday, so it's a Boss Rematch! Same moves, plus a secret weapon. Let's go!

scenes.heading: REMATCH RULES
scenes.say: The rematch rules. Clear the fractions. Distribute. Solve. Then the secret weapon: plug it back in.

scenes.heading: ROUND ONE
scenes.say: Three times x minus one, plus x over two, equals eleven. Times two, every term! Seven x minus six equals twenty-two. x equals four!

scenes.heading: THE CHECK
scenes.note: Wrong answer? The check catches it.
scenes.say: Now check it. Three times three is nine, plus four over two is two. Eleven! It matches, so lock it in.

scenes.ask: What is the value of x?
scenes.say: Rematch time! Twenty-five XP on the line. Two times x minus three, plus x over two, equals nine. Find x, then check it. Tap your answer below the video!

question.prompt: 2(x − 3) + x/2 = 9. What is the value of x?
question.explain: Multiply every term by 2: 4(x − 3) + x = 18, so 5x − 12 = 18 and x = 6. Check: 2(3) + 6/2 = 6 + 3 = 9.

trap_notes.0: Forgot to multiply the 9 by 2 (5x − 12 = 9 gives x = 4.2)
trap_notes.1: Distributed the 2 only to x: wrote 2x − 3 instead of 2x − 6 (gives x = 4.8)
trap_notes.3: Only doubled the fraction, not 2(x − 3) (2x − 6 + x = 18 gives x = 8)

rapid.prompt: Mia has $50 and saves $6/week. Leo has $10 and saves $14/week. In how many weeks will they have the same?

rapid.why: × 3 every term: x + 6x − 6 = 36, so 7x = 42. No need to find x!
